metadata.subject: index
metadata.caveat: Membership is a claim a person made in the roster; this draws it and cannot tell whether a repository drives what its family drives. Solid grey edges are claims, gold edges are seams declared in the interop registry, and dashed edges are measured from a member's own manifests and never place it. 12 member(s) had no clone this export could read, so nothing was measured for them: benchmark, factorio-sysops, holophonor, joe, leo, otto, qmcli-godot, qmetronome, scad-chess, streaming-infrastructure, uPhonor, ztgui. 2 measured link(s) have no declared seam: qmcp → vox, alfred → otto. Each is a seam nobody has stated, not a fault.
